categories.name: Strength Training
categories.description: Build muscle and strength with targeted resistance workouts.

categories.name: Cardio
categories.description: Improve endurance and burn calories with cardio training.

workouts.name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in a plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower your body until your chest nearly touches the floor, keeping elbows at 45°.
Push back up to the starting position, keeping your core tight throughout.
workouts.tips: Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.

workouts.name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the bench with feet flat on the floor, grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower the bar slowly to mid-chest.
Press the bar back up until arms are fully extended.
workouts.tips: Keep shoulder blades pulled back and down.

workouts.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set the bench to a 30-45° incline and hold a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
Press the dumbbells up until arms are extended.
Lower back down with control to the starting position.
workouts.tips: Targets the upper chest more than a flat press.

workouts.name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells above your chest with a slight bend in the elbows.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in an arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Bring the dumbbells back up to the starting position, squeezing your chest.
workouts.tips: Don't let the elbows lock or drop too low to protect the shoulders.

workouts.name: Chest Dips
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with arms extended, leaning torso slightly forward.
Lower your body until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Push back up to the starting position.
workouts.tips: Leaning forward shifts more emphasis onto the chest.

workouts.name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulders.
Pull your body up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself back down with control.
workouts.tips: Avoid swinging; keep the movement controlled.

workouts.name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at the machine and grip the bar wider than shoulder-width.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest while keeping your torso upright.
Slowly return the bar to the starting position.
workouts.tips: Focus on pulling with your back, not your arms.

workouts.name: Bent Over Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips holding a barbell, back flat and knees slightly bent.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribcage, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar back down with control.
workouts.tips: Keep your core braced to protect your lower back.

workouts.name: Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, barbell over mid-foot, and grip just outside your legs.
Keep your back flat as you lift the bar by extending your hips and knees together.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control, hinging at the hips first.
workouts.tips: Keep the bar close to your body throughout the lift.

workouts.name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit at the cable row machine with knees slightly bent, grip the handle.
Pull the handle toward your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms back out with control.
workouts.tips: Keep your torso upright, avoid using momentum.

workouts.name: Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the weight at shoulder height.
Press the weight overhead until arms are fully extended.
Lower back down to shoulder height with control.
workouts.tips: Keep your core tight to avoid arching your lower back.

workouts.name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lower back down with control.
workouts.tips: Use a slight bend in the elbows and avoid swinging.

workouts.name: Front Raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Raise one or both arms straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Lower back down with control.
workouts.tips: Avoid using momentum from your lower back.

workouts.name: Arnold Press
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing you.
Press the dumbbells overhead while rotating your palms to face forward.
Reverse the motion to return to the starting position.
workouts.tips: Move slowly to maintain control through the rotation.

workouts.name: Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips holding dumbbells with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower back down with control.
workouts.tips: Keep the movement slow to isolate the rear delts.

workouts.name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip, arms extended.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, keeping elbows close to your torso.
Lower the bar back down with control.
workouts.tips: Avoid swinging your body to lift the weight.

workouts.name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower back down with control, alternating or together.
workouts.tips: Keep your elbows fixed at your sides throughout.

workouts.name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with palms facing your torso (neutral grip).
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders keeping the neutral grip.
Lower back down with control.
workouts.tips: Also engages the forearms and brachialis.

workouts.name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench, elbow braced against your inner thigh, holding a dumbbell.
Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Lower back down slowly with full control.
workouts.tips: Focus on squeezing the bicep at the top.

workouts.name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at the preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad, holding an EZ bar.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower back down slowly without fully locking out the elbows.
workouts.tips: The preacher bench prevents cheating with momentum.

workouts.name: Tricep Dip
instructions: Support your body on a bench or bars with arms extended, torso upright.
Lower your body by bending your elbows to about 90°.
Push back up to the starting position.
workouts.tips: Keep elbows pointing backward, not flaring out.

workouts.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip the bar with hands shoulder-width apart.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping elbows close to your body.
Press the bar back up to full extension.
workouts.tips: A narrower grip shifts emphasis to the triceps.

workouts.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand or sit holding a dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms back up to the starting position.
workouts.tips: Keep your elbows pointed forward and stationary.

workouts.name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Stand at a cable machine holding a bar or rope attachment at chest height.
Push the attachment down until your arms are fully extended.
Slowly return to the starting position.
workouts.tips: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.

workouts.name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar with arms extended above your chest.
Lower the bar toward your forehead by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms back up to the starting position.
workouts.tips: Keep upper arms stationary throughout the movement.

workouts.name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit with forearms resting on your thighs, palms facing up, holding the weight.
Lower the weight by extending your wrists.
Curl the weight back up by flexing your wrists.
workouts.tips: Use a light weight and focus on wrist movement only.

workouts.name: Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit with forearms resting on your thighs, palms facing down, holding the weight.
Lower the weight by flexing your wrists downward.
Raise the weight back up by extending your wrists.
workouts.tips: Keep movements slow and controlled.

workouts.name: Farmer's Carry
instructions: Hold a heavy dumbbell or kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Walk forward for the set distance while keeping your core tight and shoulders back.
Set the weights down with control at the end.
workouts.tips: Grip the weight firmly without letting your shoulders shrug.

workouts.name: Plate Pinch Hold
instructions: Pinch two weight plates together (smooth sides out) with your fingers and thumb.
Hold the plates at your side for the target time.
Set the plates down with control.
workouts.tips: Great for building crushing and pinch grip strength.

workouts.name: Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand holding a bar with an overhand (palms down) grip.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders keeping the overhand grip.
Lower back down with control.
workouts.tips: Builds forearm and brachioradialis strength.

workouts.name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Position the bar on your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and hips to lower down until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to return to standing.
workouts.tips: Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

workouts.name: Walking Lunges
instructions: Stand tall and step forward with one leg, lowering your hips until both knees are bent 90°.
Push off the front foot to step into the next lunge.
Continue alternating legs for the set.
workouts.tips: Keep your front knee aligned with your ankle.

workouts.name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in the leg press machine with feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Lower the platform by bending your knees toward your chest.
Press back up to the starting position without locking your knees.
workouts.tips: Keep your lower back pressed against the pad.

workouts.name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pad resting on your lower shins.
Extend your legs until they are straight.
Lower back down with control.
workouts.tips: Avoid locking your knees forcefully at the top.

workouts.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand a couple feet in front of a bench and rest one foot on it behind you.
Lower your body by bending your front knee until your thigh is parallel to the floor.
Push through your front heel to return to standing.
workouts.tips: Keep your torso upright throughout the movement.

workouts.name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding the weight in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips, lowering the weight along your legs while keeping a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.
workouts.tips: Keep a slight bend in the knees throughout.

workouts.name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down on the machine with the pad resting just above your heels.
Curl your legs up by bending your knees as far as possible.
Lower back down with control.
workouts.tips: Avoid lifting your hips off the pad.

workouts.name: Good Morning
instructions: Position a barbell on your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge at the hips, lowering your torso forward while keeping your back flat.
Return to standing by driving your hips forward.
workouts.tips: Use light weight until your form is solid.

workouts.name: Glute Ham Raise
instructions: Position yourself in the GHD machine with ankles secured.
Lower your torso forward with control, resisting with your hamstrings.
Curl back up to the starting position using your hamstrings and glutes.
workouts.tips: A challenging move — build up gradually.

workouts.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Hinge forward at the hips, extending the free leg back for balance.
Return to standing by driving your hips forward.
workouts.tips: Focus on balance and a slow, controlled tempo.

workouts.name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench, barbell over your hips.
Drive your hips upward until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Lower back down with control.
workouts.tips: Squeeze your glutes hard at the top of the movement.

workouts.name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes until your body forms a straight line.
Lower back down with control.
workouts.tips: Avoid overarching your lower back at the top.

workouts.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Glute Focus)
instructions: Rest your rear foot on a bench, front foot planted forward.
Lower into a lunge, pushing your hips back to emphasize the glutes.
Drive through your front heel to return to standing.
workouts.tips: Leaning slightly forward shifts more load to the glutes.

workouts.name: Cable Kickback
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and stand facing the machine.
Kick your leg back and up, squeezing your glute at the top.
Return to the starting position with control.
workouts.tips: Keep your torso stable and avoid swinging.

workouts.name: Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes pointed out, holding a weight.
Lower into a squat, keeping your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to return to standing.
workouts.tips: The wide stance emphasizes the glutes and inner thighs.

workouts.name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a raised platform, heels hanging off.
Raise your heels as high as possible by contracting your calves.
Lower your heels back down below the platform level with control.
workouts.tips: Pause briefly at the top for a stronger contraction.

workouts.name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit at the machine with the pad resting on your thighs and balls of feet on the platform.
Raise your heels as high as possible.
Lower back down with control below platform level.
workouts.tips: Targets the soleus muscle more than standing raises.

workouts.name: Jump Rope Calf Raises
instructions: Hold a jump rope or simply mimic the motion, staying on the balls of your feet.
Perform quick, small hops using your calves to drive the movement.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set duration.
workouts.tips: Land softly to protect your ankles and knees.

workouts.name: Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Bend forward at the hips with the balls of your feet on a raised platform.
Raise your heels as high as possible by contracting your calves.
Lower back down with control.
workouts.tips: The bent-over position increases the stretch on the calves.

workouts.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on one leg with the ball of your foot on a raised platform.
Raise your heel as high as possible.
Lower back down with control below platform level.
workouts.tips: Hold onto something for balance if needed.

workouts.name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl your shoulders up off the floor, contracting your abs.
Lower back down with control.
workouts.tips: Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands.

workouts.name: Plank
instructions: Position yourself on your forearms and toes, body in a straight line.
Engage your core and hold the position without letting your hips sag.
Breathe steadily throughout the hold.
workouts.tips: Squeeze your glutes to help keep your hips level.

workouts.name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands at your sides.
Raise your legs up until they are vertical, keeping them straight.
Lower back down with control without touching the floor.
workouts.tips: Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.

workouts.name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent, leaning back slightly, holding a weight.
Rotate your torso to tap the weight on the floor beside your hip.
Rotate to the other side and continue alternating.
workouts.tips: Lift your feet off the floor for an added challenge.

workouts.name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with hands behind your head and knees bent.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg out.
Alternate sides in a pedaling motion.
workouts.tips: Move slowly and focus on the twist, not speed.

workouts.name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side, propped up on one forearm, feet stacked.
Lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line.
Hold the position, then switch sides.
workouts.tips: Keep your hips high and avoid sagging.

workouts.name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with knees bent, leaning back slightly, holding a weight in both hands.
Rotate your torso side to side, tapping the weight near your hip each time.
Keep your core engaged throughout.
workouts.tips: Slow the movement down to increase difficulty.

workouts.name: Cable Woodchopper
instructions: Stand sideways to a cable machine set at a high position, holding the handle with both hands.
Pull the handle diagonally down across your body toward your opposite hip.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat, then switch sides.
workouts.tips: Rotate through your torso, not just your arms.

workouts.name: Standing Side Bend
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Bend sideways at the waist, lowering the dumbbell toward your knee.
Return to standing and repeat, then switch sides.
workouts.tips: Keep the movement controlled, avoid leaning forward or back.

workouts.name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with hands behind your head and knees bent.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Alternate sides continuously in a pedaling motion.
workouts.tips: Focus on rotating through the ribcage for full oblique engagement.

cardioWorkouts.name: Steady-State Run
instructions: Warm up with 5 minutes of brisk walking.
Run at a conversational, steady pace for the target duration.
Cool down with 5 minutes of walking.

cardioWorkouts.name: Interval Sprints
instructions: Warm up with light jogging for 5 minutes.
Sprint at maximum effort for 30 seconds, then walk or jog for 60 seconds.
Repeat the cycle for the target duration, then cool down.

cardioWorkouts.name: Hill Repeats
instructions: Warm up, then find a moderate incline hill.
Run up the hill at a hard effort, then walk back down to recover.
Repeat for the target duration.

cardioWorkouts.name: Long Slow Run
instructions: Warm up with a few minutes of walking.
Run at an easy, sustainable pace for the entire duration.
Cool down and stretch afterward.

cardioWorkouts.name: Steady-State Ride
instructions: Warm up with 5 minutes of easy pedaling.
Maintain a steady, moderate pace for the target duration.
Cool down with easy pedaling for 5 minutes.

cardioWorkouts.name: Cycling HIIT Intervals
instructions: Warm up with 5 minutes of light pedaling.
Pedal at maximum resistance/effort for 30 seconds, then recover for 90 seconds.
Repeat for the target duration, then cool down.

cardioWorkouts.name: Hill Climb Ride
instructions: Warm up, then increase resistance to simulate a climb.
Maintain a strong steady effort while climbing for several minutes.
Recover on flat resistance, then repeat.

cardioWorkouts.name: Endurance Ride
instructions: Warm up with easy pedaling.
Ride at a comfortable, sustainable pace for the full duration.
Cool down and stretch your legs afterward.

cardioWorkouts.name: Basic Jump Rope
instructions: Hold the rope handles and swing it overhead using your wrists.
Jump just high enough to clear the rope as it passes underfoot.
Maintain a steady rhythm for the target duration.

cardioWorkouts.name: Jump Rope Intervals
instructions: Jump rope at a fast pace for 30 seconds.
Rest for 30 seconds.
Repeat the cycle for the target duration.

cardioWorkouts.name: Double Unders
instructions: Swing the rope faster than a normal jump, passing it under your feet twice per jump.
Jump slightly higher than a basic jump to allow the extra pass.
Practice in short sets, resting as needed.

cardioWorkouts.name: Freestyle Jump Rope
instructions: Mix basic jumps with alternate-foot steps and high knees.
Keep a continuous rhythm, switching patterns every 30-60 seconds.
Rest briefly between pattern changes as needed.

cardioWorkouts.name: Bodyweight HIIT Circuit
instructions: Warm up for 5 minutes with light movement.
Perform burpees, jump squats, mountain climbers, and high knees for 40 seconds each, resting 20 seconds between.
Complete 3-4 rounds of the circuit, then cool down.

cardioWorkouts.name: Tabata Intervals
instructions: Choose one or two exercises like squats or burpees.
Work at maximum effort for 20 seconds, then rest for 10 seconds.
Repeat for 8 rounds (4 minutes), then rest and repeat with a new exercise.

cardioWorkouts.name: Kettlebell HIIT
instructions: Warm up with light movement.
Perform kettlebell swings, goblet squats, and snatches for 40 seconds each, resting 20 seconds between.
Complete 3-4 rounds, then cool down.

cardioWorkouts.name: Sprint Interval Training
instructions: Warm up with light jogging.
Sprint at full effort for 15-20 seconds, then walk to recover for 40 seconds.
Repeat for the target duration, then cool down.

cardioWorkouts.name: Freestyle Laps
instructions: Warm up with a few easy laps.
Swim continuous freestyle laps at a steady, sustainable pace.
Cool down with slow, relaxed laps.

cardioWorkouts.name: Swim Interval Training
instructions: Warm up with easy laps.
Swim one lap at high effort, then rest for 20-30 seconds.
Repeat for the target duration, then cool down.

cardioWorkouts.name: Mixed Stroke Swim
instructions: Warm up with freestyle laps.
Alternate between freestyle, backstroke, and breaststroke every few laps.
Cool down with easy paced swimming.

cardioWorkouts.name: Endurance Swim
instructions: Warm up with a few easy laps.
Swim continuously at a moderate, sustainable pace for the full duration.
Cool down with slow laps and stretch after exiting the pool.

cardioWorkouts.name: Steady-State Row
instructions: Sit on the rower with feet strapped in, knees bent, arms extended.
Drive through your legs, then lean back and pull the handle to your chest.
Reverse the motion smoothly and repeat at a steady pace for the duration.

cardioWorkouts.name: Rowing Intervals
instructions: Warm up with 5 minutes of easy rowing.
Row at high intensity for 500m, then rest for 90 seconds.
Repeat for the target number of rounds, then cool down.

cardioWorkouts.name: Endurance Row
instructions: Warm up with light rowing.
Maintain a steady, sustainable pace for the full duration.
Cool down with slow rowing and stretch afterward.

cardioWorkouts.name: Power Stroke Intervals
instructions: Warm up with easy rowing.
Row 10 powerful, explosive strokes, then row easy for 30 seconds.
Repeat the cycle for the target duration.
